fix(useAxios): handle optional response data safely When cancelling duplicate requests, the error message "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')" appears.

feat(createReusableTemplate): add support for specifying component names

This adds support for passing a component name to createReusableTemplate().  This is useful for development/debugging, e.g. in the component view in the Vue DevTools:  - Before: each instance is listed twice (once for the ‘define’ and once for the ‘reuse’ part) as ‘Anonymous Component’. This quickly becomes unwieldy and hard to navigate.  - After this change: components are shown in DevTools
